type_rules: Every command request includes COMMAND_ENVELOPE_V1 and resolves its exact body contract from the named command leaf; path identities are immutable UUIDs unless explicitly WFM/provider identities.
All query cursors use CURSOR_V1 with deterministic owner-defined ordering; client-supplied aggregate/envelope/outcome values are never authoritative.
implementation_rule: Route request_type/response_type names resolve across both declared leaves. The aggregate file is an index and does not weaken unknown-field rejection, bounds or command-envelope requirements.
